scope: Rendered Vue application with isolated in-memory Tauri IPC fixture; browser acceptance only

dimensions.name: informationHierarchy
dimensions.evidence: Needs attention precedes current work; long goal text and usage collapsed.

dimensions.name: navigation
dimensions.evidence: Explicit workbench and six workspace tabs; route identifies task scope.

dimensions.name: typography
dimensions.evidence: 26/16/14/12px hierarchy; measured visible minimum 12px at four widths.

dimensions.name: spacingAndDensity
dimensions.evidence: Distinct glass panels, row dividers; lower sections require deliberate scrolling.

dimensions.name: colorAndMaterial
dimensions.evidence: Dark/light surfaces and independent semantic state colors; 12 palette/theme primary contrast minimum 4.99.

dimensions.name: interactionClarity
dimensions.evidence: Task/diagnostic links are precise; feedback and draft errors remain visible.

dimensions.name: responsive
dimensions.evidence: 390px reflows navigation and content; measured no page overflow at 390/900/1024/1440.

limitations: Native Tauri rendering and IPC interaction acceptance blocked by locked macOS desktop.
Baseline native screenshot and final browser fixture screenshots use different data and viewport; comparison is structural, not pixel-identical.
Subjective visual scores do not substitute for user acceptance.
iterationEvidence: Failure drafts preserved; duplicate acceptance after successful mutation and failed read removed; error rows direct to diagnostics; semantic primary foreground contrast fixed.
